user.title: Set up Sendspin
user.description: Home Assistant will act as a Sendspin server so it can adopt and control Sendspin speakers on your network. It does not play audio itself and does not advertise itself over mDNS.

data_description.name: The name speakers see when Home Assistant connects to them.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Sendspin found on your network
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found {name}. Setting Sendspin up lets you adopt and control Sendspin speakers. No speaker is adopted until you choose one — adopting takes a speaker away from whatever is currently using it.

data_description.name: The name speakers see when Home Assistant connects to them.

abort.not_sendspin: This device does not look like a Sendspin server or player.

user.title: Adopt a Sendspin speaker
user.description:
Adopting a speaker makes Home Assistant its Sendspin server. If Music Assistant or another Sendspin server is currently using it, that server will lose it, and it may take it straight back. Home Assistant cannot play audio to a speaker in this version — adopting gives you volume, mute and presence.

Seen on your network: {discovered}
